brief:
Israeli occupation forces issued evacuation orders for two homes in the western area of Beita, south of Nablus, early Friday morning, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said occupation forces entered the western section of the town and delivered the demolition notices to residents of the affected properties.

The orders affect families in the Palestinian town located in the central West Bank. Beita has faced repeated Israeli military operations and settlement-related pressures in recent years. Demolition orders targeting Palestinian homes are a recurring phenomenon across the occupied West Bank, affecting dozens of families annually.
